posts.quote:
Snow on the high ridges,
still green below.
The mountain changes seasons
from the top down.

Grey sky, quiet woods.
Not every good day
needs the sun.

The lake doesn't hurry,
and neither does the mist.
Maybe I can learn
to do the same.

Late light on the stone.
The best part of the day
is the slow walk down.

In every walk with nature
one receives far more
than he seeks.
posts.author: John Muir

posts.quote:
We came for the view.
We stayed for the quiet
that came with it.

Cold morning, clear sky,
heavy pack, light heart.
That's the whole plan.
